definition: Monotonic seconds from issuing the pod delete request to the first poll that lists a pod with a new UID matching namespace+selector. Kubernetes object existence only; upper bound with one poll interval of resolution; includes kubectl start-up and API latency.
error_message: no pod with a new UID matching the selector appeared in 3 poll(s)

definition: Monotonic seconds from the first poll that lists the replacement pod to the first poll that shows its Ready condition True. Kubernetes readiness only, NOT ROS application recovery; resolution of one poll interval (0 = already Ready when first seen).
error_message: no pod with a new UID matching the selector appeared in 3 poll(s)

definition: Replacement metadata.creationTimestamp (API-server clock, 1 s resolution) minus the local wall-clock time of the delete request. Affected by clock skew; null if negative.
error_message: no pod with a new UID matching the selector appeared in 3 poll(s)

definition: Ready condition lastTransitionTime minus replacement creationTimestamp, both Kubernetes timestamps with 1 s resolution. Auxiliary; readiness only; null if negative.
error_message: no pod with a new UID matching the selector appeared in 3 poll(s)

definition: Time of the replacement pod's Scheduled event minus its creationTimestamp. Scheduling only. Events are best-effort and may be missing. No Started event is used anywhere.
error_message: no pod with a new UID matching the selector appeared in 3 poll(s)

definition: Seconds from disruption to the first ROS message restored, taken from a supplied message probe on the probe's own clock. NOT MEASURED unless a probe input is supplied.
